items.title: Rama Natha's Belief
items.explanation: Rama Natha believed that there was a magic potion capable of turning any object into gold.

items.title: The Sage's Advice
items.explanation: The sage Mahipati told Rama Natha to plant a banana tree, water it regularly with his hands, and collect the morning dew on the leaves in winter. He instructed him to store five litres of dew in a bottle.

items.title: Rama Natha's Hard Work
items.explanation: After six years, Rama Natha planted many banana plants, tended them carefully, and collected dew with his own hands, eventually having a huge banana plantation.

items.title: The Sage's Trick
items.explanation: The sage did not give the magic potion because he knew that hard work creates wealth rather than magic. He told Rama Natha that if he had known earlier, he would have listened to him instead of cheating him.

items.title: Rama Natha's Understanding
items.explanation: Rama Natha understood the sage's wisdom and decided to work even harder on his plantation from that day forward.
